ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT(this "Agreement"), made as of the 8"h day of June, 2017, by and between 77 GRAHAM REALTY LLC 199 Lee Ave, POB 103, Brooklyn NY 11211 (the “Owner") and 85 GRAHAM REALTY LLC, a New York limited liability company, having its principal address at 320 Roebling #304, Brooklyn NY 11211 (*"Developer") (Owner and Developer, collectively, the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as f/k/a 77-85 Graham Avenue a/k/a 92-96 Siegel Street, Brooklyn,NewYork,n/k/a 77 Graham Avenue,Brooklyn,NewYork,and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map") as Block 3096, Lot 20, which is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto being referred to hereinafter collectively as "Owner's Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the "Owner's Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, f/k/a 77-85 Graham Avenue a/k/a 92-96 Siegel Street, Brooklyn, New York, n/k/a 83 Graham Avenue, Brooklyn, New York and identified on the Tax Map as Block 3096, Lot 19, which is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein after called “Developer's Land"; said building(s) and structure(s) located thereon as of the date hereof are herein referred to as the “Existing Developer's Building"); WHEREAS, Developer may demolish the Existing Developer's Building and construct a new building (the “New Building"), and construct other improvements associated with such new building (the Existing Developer's Building and the New Building, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as "Developer's Building"; Developer's Land and Developer's Building, are herein collectively referred to as the "Developer's Parcel"); WHEREAS, Owner's Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on Owner's Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on Developer's Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined);
